import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source_files_0_to_8 = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_8.csv",
]

source_file_9 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_64/training_9.csv"

# Read and union sources 0 to 8
dfs_0_to_8 = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files_0_to_8]
union_0_to_8 = pd.concat(dfs_0_to_8, ignore_index=True)

# Read source 9
df_9 = pd.read_csv(source_file_9, index_col=0)

# Union the above two results
final_df = pd.concat([union_0_to_8, df_9], ignore_index=True)

# Drop any extra columns not in target schema (e.g., 'Unnamed: 0' if present)
final_df = final_df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
final_df = final_df.astype({
    'admit': 'int64',
    'gre': 'int64',
    'gpa': 'float64',
    'prestige': 'int64'
})

# Write to target CSV file without index
final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
